'''Cahill''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Cahill was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] when he spotted [[House of Thul|Thul]] agents taking heavy equipment to an [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]] weather tower. He wasn't sure what to do, so he tasked a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to travel to [[Wardpost Hurne]] and report it to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barra]].
